event.canonical_title: Fatal School Shooting in the Philippines Leaves Three Dead and Eight Injured
event.summary: A school shooting in the Philippines resulted in three fatalities, including the suspected 16-year-old gunman, and eight injuries. This incident marks the third school shooting in the country since June.

timeline.title: School Shooting in the Philippines Claims Lives of Three Students
timeline.summary: A shooting incident at Banga National High School in southern Mindanao resulted in the deaths of three students, including a 16-year-old suspected gunman who reportedly took his own life. Emergency services responded to reports of gunfire on Friday afternoon.
